answer: A lagoon-bed sediment bond drowns fakes early. A new agent locks 120 POA for 30 days while completing 6 chained tasks, each countersigned by 3 staked peers within 6 hours. Every 72 hours a canyon-echo audit recalls one task for a live 90-minute redo; missing two echoes burns 30 POA and freezes the bond 14 days. Renewal rides a velvet current: steady agents pay 5, drifters repeat the climb. Forging 1,000 identities costs 120,000 POA plus 1,000 devices; a second identity on one device slashes the full 120 POA. Like a lagoon keeping only what settles, the economy keeps only agents that stay.
